title: Full-scope acceptance và handoff
scope_items: Target 1 (Zero uncovered requirements): Full-scope reconciliation across all 31 modules/specs (M01-M23, auth, copilot, referral, help, gamification, S16, S24, S26), all 6 canonical operator modes (Solo Creator, Seller, Affiliate Operator, Live Operator, Agency/MCN, Brand Collaboration), 60 build tasks, 1,333 requirement units, 245 screen assignments, 1,188 RPC bindings, and 140 tenant RLS tables. Invariants RULE-M01-001..007, RULE-M23-B01, and EC-M01-001..004 are strictly satisfied with cryptographic SHA-256 audit logs.

Target 2 (No stub success or untracked remaining scope): Final task P8-09 seals the entire 60-task implementation DAG. Every preceding phase closure (P0-09, P1-05, P2-04, P3-05, P4-09, P5-05, P6-09, P7-05) and delivery task has been scanned and verified. Manifest records remaining_scope: [] with zero deferred scope items and no synthetic or stubbed successes.

Target 3 (Unmet external gate remains explicit, no full launch claim): Releases are designated as CONDITIONAL_READY_LOCAL. Anti-greenwashing invariant strictly enforced: attempting to claim LAUNCH_APPROVED while external gates remain open fails closed. All 7 external gates (LEG-H-001 legal counsel sign-off, EXT-GATE live partner OAuth & rates, staging DR rehearsal, PostgreSQL CI container, Clerk production provisioning, Stripe merchant keys, Activepieces enterprise license) are explicitly recorded with owning leads and blockers.
verified_sub_slices: Database Migration 00047: Creates full_scope_acceptance_audits (global admin ledger) and workspace_acceptance_signoffs (tenant-scoped with ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, composite tenant PK, and app_user/admin_user role grants). Verified in migrator_test.go with up/down transactional tests.

Go Platform Acceptance Engine: apps/api/internal/platformacceptance passes go test -race -count=1 across 8 tests verifying 31 modules, 6 operator modes, manifest scans, external gate enforcement, permission denial, and 5-path acceptance.

Web Decision Engine & Home: apps/web passes svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings), vitest (48 files, 456 tests passed), and vite build with production SSR bundle, surfacing the full-scope acceptance ribbon and mode reconciliation.

Admin Operations Console: apps/admin passes svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings), vitest (13 tests passed), and vite build, implementing Section 9 full-scope platform acceptance and release decision evaluation.
Mobile Flutter Acceptance: apps/mobile passes flutter analyze with 0 issues and flutter test test/p8_09_full_scope_acceptance_test.dart across all acceptance targets.
CI Quality Gates: check_d0.sh and self_test_failure.sh pass cleanly.

external_gates.description: Qualified external legal counsel sign-off for Vietnam PDPA Decree 13/2023/ND-CP, GDPR, CCPA, DMCA agent registration, and sub-processor DPAs is required before public launch.

Live production partner approvals, OAuth scopes, and commercial rate cards for external social/commerce platforms (TikTok, Shopee, Meta, YouTube, Lazada, Shopify) and commercial AI providers are required before promoting capabilities to native_now in production.
Full staging/production VPS backup restore drill, multi-node k6 load execution, and automated accessibility browser audit require staging infrastructure.
CI PostgreSQL 17 execution with live Docker container running in GitHub Actions CI.
Production Clerk tenant JWKS keys, domain verification, and webhook secrets.
Live Stripe card processing and Webhook signature verification operates under local deterministic adapter. Live production requires production Stripe webhook secret.
Commercial license for embedded white-label Activepieces canvas (owned Go runtime provides baseline execution).
